source.name: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D bone labels with curated study terminology
source.placement_notes: Original atlas leaders, mirrored leaders and curated study coordinates remain in initial_placement. Label anchors prefer original native selections and accepted source-region transfers. Other CT guides use per-bone similarity ICP and regularized nonrigid shape registration, with normal-compatible surface projection and round-trip diagnostics. Explicit inner/outer vault labels use exposed native cortex. Supported junctions and sagittal contour extrema are fitted directly on each specimen. Empty-space guides are not snapped onto arbitrary walls. All positions remain approximate and lack independent anatomical ground truth; no accuracy percentage is claimed.

internal_layers.description: Compact outer and inner tables, diploe and trabecular architecture require a separate real micro-CT bone specimen. The skull meshes do not segment these tissue layers.

limitations: Individual nutrient foramina, diploic canals, every tiny olfactory opening and variable accessory foramina are not individually segmented or counted.
Internal canal courses, bony labyrinth and air-cell partitions are not reconstructed by point annotations.
Metopic, accessory occipital, squamomastoid and incisive sutures, infant fontanelles and other developmental variants are not fabricated on this adult skull.
Reference auditory-ossicle and hyoid landmarks are available only in the reference model; these bones are absent from the CT specimen.
